verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an enterprise AI customer-support platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions self-hosting, on-prem, or customer-managed deployment. The docs describe a vendor-run platform with integrations, security features, and no-code configuration, none of which amount to self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
